integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, high-budget commercial flash ad, a 16:9 wide shot frames the complete six-panel black-and-white storyboard exactly as shown in <Picture 1>, preserving the panel borders, the T1–T6 labels, the boy Xiaoxing, the three-wheeled scooter, the city street, the cloud-road fantasy route, and the visible Chinese annotations "小星", "星轨滑板车", "晨光城市街道", and "云端乐园". The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed toward the dashed arrow between the scooter and the sky route as thin color bands begin to run through the black ink: warm sunrise yellow fills the sun, pale cyan spreads into the sky, fresh green washes through the street trees, Xiaoxing's helmet gains glossy white with red star decals, his hoodie turns bright sky blue, his backpack becomes orange, and the scooter gains a clean silver frame with teal wheels and a glowing star badge. [Shot 2] At 00:01.600, the shot cuts into the T1 panel as the flat storyboard border becomes a bold graphic frame; Xiaoxing stands beside the scooter on the morning sidewalk, and oversized text "小星出发" slides in from the left, overshoots, and snaps into place beside him. The camera trucks right with small amplitude at fast speed as Xiaoxing taps the handlebar, the scooter's star badge lights up, and a thin teal line races from the front wheel across the pavement. [Shot 3] At 00:03.200, the teal line matches into the T2 panel, where Xiaoxing places one foot on the deck and pushes off; the text "一脚点亮晨光" pops upward from the wheel trail and breaks into tiny star shapes. The camera tracks him at fast speed as the scooter rolls forward, the silver handlebar stays steady in both hands, his blue hoodie and orange backpack bounce lightly, and the city behind him fills with saturated morning colors. [Shot 4] At 00:04.800, the shot cuts to a low front angle from the T3 road perspective, with Xiaoxing riding toward the camera and the scooter wheels spinning clean teal rings. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at fast speed as the street lane stretches ahead, the distant fantasy castle above the clouds becomes golden and lavender, and a bold diagonal caption "不只是通勤" tears across the right side before folding into the road markings. [Shot 5] At 00:06.400, the folded road marking becomes a paper ramp inside the T4 panel; Xiaoxing rides up from the city street onto a soft cloud bridge, keeping the same helmet, hoodie, backpack, and scooter design. The camera tilts up with large amplitude at fast speed as the scooter lifts from the ramp, a dotted arrow beneath him turns into a glittering teal star trail, and the caption "还能把路变成想象力" curves along the trail before scattering behind the wheels. [Shot 6] At 00:08.800, the camera cuts to the T5 sky view, where floating islands and cloud castles surround Xiaoxing as he rides through the air on the scooter, still balanced with both hands on the handlebar. The camera performs an arc shot with small amplitude at fast speed around him as the black storyboard cloud lines finish colorizing into creamy white clouds with peach shadows, the castles glow in soft gold, and the moving trail draws a giant star shape that briefly frames the product. [Shot 7] At 00:11.200, the star shape wipes into the T6 wide cloud-highway composition; Xiaoxing becomes smaller in frame as he follows the sweeping sky road toward the cloud amusement city. The camera tracks behind him at fast speed, then pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the scooter's rear wheel as large readable product text "星轨滑板车" assembles from the wheel trail, each character bouncing once on the beat. [Shot 8] At 00:13.600, the shot cuts to a clean commercial end composition: Xiaoxing stops on a bright cloud platform, plants one sneaker beside the scooter deck, and turns the scooter slightly so the silver frame, teal wheels, and glowing star badge face the viewer. The camera holds a static shot as the final slogan "把城市骑成云端乐园" appears above him in bold warm yellow and teal lettering, the original storyboard panel edges remain faintly visible behind the full-color scene, and the product name "星轨滑板车" locks beneath the scooter for the final beat.

overall_soundscape: Paper rustles and pencil-like line scratches open the storyboard before the scene fills with morning city ambience, distant traffic, birds, and soft wind. The scooter produces clean wheel spins, handlebar clicks, light deck taps, and airy whooshes as it rides from pavement onto clouds. Xiaoxing's excited breathing and brief laughter are heard during the lift into the sky, followed by a gentle cloud-surface puff when he stops.

non_diegetic_music: Fast 150 BPM electronic pop with bright synth plucks, tight claps, and a four-on-the-floor kick, adding short brass hits when the color spreads through the panels. The track drops at 00:06.400 with a rising arpeggio and heavier drums as the scooter reaches the cloud ramp, then opens into wider synth chords for the sky-road sequence. The final beat at 00:13.600 lands with a crisp impact, leaving a short shimmering tail under the slogan.
